attempts.summary: Set up centralized log forwarding: node2 runs an inventory systemd service (logging heartbeats via logger -t inventory) forwarded by rsyslog over TCP/514 to node1, where rsyslog (imtcp) writes matching messages to /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Config is persisted via systemd enablement and rsyslog.d files, and firewalld on node1 permanently allows tcp/514. Verified the pipeline survives independent reboots of both node1 and node2, with boot-id proof of actual restarts and continuous, correctly-timestamped log delivery afterward.
